stone.description: The gray foundation of the Overworld. Mining it normally gives cobblestone; preserving the original block requires Silk Touch or a furnace.
stone.appearance: A mottled gray full cube with a fine, irregular stone texture.
acquisition: Mine with a Silk Touch pickaxe to collect stone.
Smelt one cobblestone in a furnace to obtain one stone.
stone.silk_touch: A Silk Touch pickaxe drops stone instead of cobblestone.

sand.description: A pale, granular block for desert landscapes and glassmaking. It falls when unsupported, so plan your excavations carefully.
sand.appearance: A pale beige full cube with a fine grain.
acquisition: Collect from deserts or beaches. A shovel is the fastest tool.
warnings: Unsupported sand falls. Avoid standing underneath it.

glass.description: A clear building block made by smelting sand. Use it for windows and bright, open structures.
glass.appearance: A transparent cube with pale edges and small reflective streaks.
acquisition: Smelt one sand in a furnace to obtain one glass.

bedrock.description: The unbreakable boundary beneath the world. Registry presence does not make this block collectible in normal Survival.
bedrock.appearance: A full cube with a dark, high-contrast gray mottled pattern.
acquisition: Not obtainable through normal Survival mining.
warnings: Do not confuse the bedrock block with Minecraft: Bedrock Edition.
